flatten_nested_structure: flatten a nested dict or list into a flat dictionary with dot-separated keys
use_pairwise_iterator: iterate over sliding pairs of consecutive elements from an iterable using pairwise
chunk_data_with_grouper: collect data into fixed-length chunks using grouper with an optional fill value
interleave_iterables_roundrobin: interleave multiple iterables in round-robin order using the roundrobin function
temporarily_set_env_vars: temporarily set environment variables using the set_env context manager
